docs.summary: Work a host adds to views: a pass in a slot of every view of a world, or of one view. Its slot, order, kinds, group and Enabled are read at SubmitFrame along with `Extract` on the host thread, everything else runs on the render thread. Of features sharing an `ExclusiveGroup` the view's wins over the world's, which wins over the built in one, so a feature replaces a built in one by taking its group: SceneClear, Cascades, Prepass, Opaque, Sky, SceneColor, Transparent or Present. A feature that throws fails the frame.
